work.title: The Odyssey of Pi
work.note: A referência é o romance da viagem de Pi e suas experiências. Life of Pi (As Aventuras de Pi) é um romance do canadense Yann Martel, publicado em 2001. A obra não fica só no pano de fundo: ela prepara a situação para praticar diferença: I have been to Rome (e voltei). She has gone to Rome (e ainda está lá).

facts.label: O que eu estava fazendo quando…
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a ação longa e o passado simples para a curta: I was walking when I saw it.

facts.label: Ação longa
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para uma ação em andamento: I was walking to the bus. She was sitting on a bench. Use was com I, he, she e it, e were com you, we e they.

facts.label: Ação curta
facts.sub: Use o passado simples para o momento que interrompe: I saw it. My bus came. Combine com when: I was walking when I saw it. A ação longa usa -ing.

pages.title: A busy street · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Tuesday afternoon on a busy street in Glasgow. A light rain falls on the stones. Eva walks fast with her bag. A woman with a red umbrella runs after her. It is a kind stranger named Iris. Iris holds up a small wallet.
“Excuse me! Is this your wallet?” says Iris. “Oh yes! Thank you so much! Where did you find it?” says Eva. “It was on that bench. I was walking to the bus when I saw it.” says Iris.
